competitor_patterns: Extreme depth: Bikerumor's top-ranking 'best cycling sunglasses 2026' post is 24,894 words — physically tested 18+ models with structured per-product H2s, a comparison table, and FAQ schema. Our best equivalent is 4,045 words.
Authoritative 'tested' framing in titles and H1s: both Bikerumor ('Bikerumor Tested') and Cyclist ('reviewed') signal hands-on authority, which drives higher CTR from SERP snippets.
Rich structured content: Bikerumor and Lensmart both use comparison tables AND FAQ schema together — only 33% of our pages have FAQ schema and several high-traffic pages lack tables.

Photochromic lens coverage is a recurring top-ranking angle: road.cc ranks #1 with a photochromic-focused review, and our photochromic posts are only ~1,100 words with no table and no FAQ schema — severely under-built.

Competitor roundups name and rank multiple brands (Julbo, Knockaround, Tifosi, Oakley, POC) — giving searchers a full market overview. Our posts are often Velluto-centric, limiting organic reach for 'best X' queries.
our_gaps: Word count gap on high-impression 'best cycling glasses 2026' queries: our best page for this is ~4,045 words vs Bikerumor's 24,894. We are getting impressions (260+150) but low CTR because the SERP snippet does not signal 'comprehensive tested guide'.

33% FAQ schema coverage: 27+ pages have no FAQ schema, meaning they are excluded from Google AI Overviews and FAQ rich results — a direct miss for near-top-3 keywords like 'oakley alternatives' (pos 6.1) and 'best cycling glasses' (pos 8.2).
